scope: Public source inspection only; no production or model requests by this agent.
findings: PostgREST v14.18 executes DbTx through SQL.transaction or SQL.unpreparedTransaction.
Its cabal dependency permits hasql-transaction >=1.0.1 and <1.2.
Inspected 1.0.1 and 1.1.1.3 transaction runners retry SQLSTATE40001 using a recursive fix without an attempt bound or delay.
The latter also retries40P01; true engine serialization/deadlock errors are not changed.
A deterministic business guard using40001 can therefore retain an API pool connection and repeatedly fail even after its caller abandons the request.
PT409 is a documented PostgreSQL custom SQLSTATE that PostgREST returns as HTTP409, without entering Hasql serialization retry.
limits: This is official tagged source evidence; the exact runtime dependency binary in Supabase was not extracted.
The migration changes only explicit application-owned business RAISE sites, never real engine SQLSTATE errors.
